Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
Urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, positive nitrites, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and low specific gravity are noted. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and consideration of antibiotic therapy.
